correctness.rationale: The seven monomials include τ⁶, α³, β², so the sextic system is basepoint free. In the displayed witness, on τ=1, g−5f=xy−2x³−3 implies x≠0 and y=(2x³+3)/x. Substitution gives 4x⁶+x⁵+12x³+x²+9; it is coprime to its derivative modulo 5 with degrees preserved, certifying six simple transverse intersections. At τ=0 the coefficient determinant 2 precludes intersections; both curves avoid the two orbifold points. Over the smooth base the cover of transverse branches is smooth. In the weight-two chart the residual sign changes both nonzero roots, acts freely on the four local sheets, and identifies them in two pairs; these two smooth points are fixed by ab, not by a or b alone. In the weight-three chart the roots have weight zero modulo 3, leaving four points, locally quotients with tangent weights (1,2). They are freely permuted by G; transporting the two exceptional-curve labels from one point gives two regular permutation modules, with independence of divisor classes from the negative-definite exceptional intersection matrix. Adjunction and crepant resolution give trivial K, and the weighted complete-intersection Koszul sequence and rationality of the singularities give H¹(O)=0. The a and b fixed curves are connected double covers of their respective smooth genus-one anticanonical curves, each branched at the six crossings; hence each has genus four. The residue character is (--), and the six crossings plus the two weight-two points account for all of ab's fixed locus. Euler characteristics minus two give the traces (22,−8,−8,6), with multiplicities (3,4,4,11); the three non-(--) spaces give eleven divisor directions and the exceptional module gives two in (--). For the dimension step, the graded base automorphisms have dimension five after scaling, and already the sample first branch has finite stabilizer: on τ=1, preservation of x³+y²+1 up to scalar under x↦Bx+C, y↦Dy+Ex+F forces E=F=C=0, B³=D²=1. Thus generic ordered pairs modulo base automorphisms have dimension seven. For fixed (S,H), an automorphism preserving H permutes the exceptional curves; if D is their sum, mH−D is ample for large m since −D is relatively ample on the contracted A2 fibers. Hence Aut(S,H) is finite. There are finitely many ordered sign-actions on (S,H), and quotient plus ordered branch data recovers the base pair. This verifies seven-dimensional moduli image, so the Noether–Lefschetz dimension bound gives very-general rank at most 13. Equality and the two claimed rational representations follow from the lower bound and orthogonal decomposition.
